config.name: Failure rate (%) by procedure
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(_timestamp) AS ts,
       toString(_json.procedure) AS procedure,
       100 * countIf(toString(_json.result) = 'failure') / count() AS "failed %"
FROM dfe.`core-probes`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp)
GROUP BY ts, procedure
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Failures by procedure and cause
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT p.procedure AS "Procedure",
       p.code AS "Cause code",
       p.cause AS "Cause",
       count() AS "Failures",
       round(100 * count() / any(t.attempts), 1) AS "Of attempts %",
       round(quantile(0.95)(p.latency)) AS "p95 ms"
FROM (SELECT toString(_json.procedure) AS procedure, toString(_json.cause_code) AS code, toString(_json.cause) AS cause, toFloat64(_json.latency_ms) AS latency FROM dfe.`core-probes` WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp) AND toString(_json.result) = 'failure') AS p
INNER JOIN (SELECT toString(_json.procedure) AS procedure, count() AS attempts FROM dfe.`core-probes` WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp) GROUP BY procedure) AS t ON p.procedure = t.procedure
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 4 DESC
LIMIT 15

config.name: p95 latency (ms) by interface
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(_timestamp) AS ts,
       toString(_json.interface) AS interface,
       quantile(0.95)(toFloat64(_json.latency_ms)) AS "p95 ms"
FROM dfe.`core-probes`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp)
GROUP BY ts, interface
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Procedures
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toString(_json.protocol) AS "Protocol",
       toString(_json.interface) AS "Interface",
       toString(_json.procedure) AS "Procedure",
       count() AS "Attempts",
       countIf(toString(_json.result) = 'failure') AS "Failures",
       round(100 * "Failures" / "Attempts", 2) AS "Failed %",
       round(median(toFloat64(_json.latency_ms)), 1) AS "Median ms",
       round(quantile(0.95)(toFloat64(_json.latency_ms)), 1) AS "p95 ms"
FROM dfe.`core-probes`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY "Failed %" DESC
